name: Tillamook Medium Cheddar Cheese (Naturally 0g Lactose)
whyItWorks: Traditional cheddar cheese undergoes natural aging and bacterial fermentation that completely consumes all lactose sugars (testing at 0g lactose per serving). Provides calcium and satisfying fat with zero lactose distress.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Melt over white bread for a gentle grilled cheese, or eat a slice with plain saltine crackers.
watchOuts: Rich in natural dairy fat; limit to 1–2 slices during active flare recovery.
